ValidationRule.description: Minimum Fields to ruquesta approve Discount
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( SM_Apply_Discount__c = TRUE, OR( ISBLANK(SM_Discount_Reason__c), ISBLANK(SM_User_Who_Request_Discount__c), ISBLANK(User_Who_Approve_Discount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(SM_Discount_Type__c)), /* exige solo el campo que corresponda al tipo */ (TEXT(SM_Discount_Type__c) = 'Value' && ISBLANK(SM_Discount_Value__c)), (TEXT(SM_Discount_Type__c) = 'Percentage' && ISBLANK(SM_Discount_Percentage__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The "Discount original Value, Discount Reason, Discount Type, Discount Value, User Who Request Discount" fields must be completed
